Basic rules for route planning on the job
Trainers ask staff to read this twice, and this page walks new staff through why

Route planning matters because the Companion Animal Travel Desk must match each animal with a safe path, the right documents, and steady cabin support. New staff should check every booking carefully, because errors at this stage can disrupt welfare, handling, and onward transfers. A calm review helps the team confirm that the animal meets travel conditions and that the shipment can move without avoidable delay.

When you review a small dog case, start with the travel file and confirm that the document set is complete. <<FACT F080>> The record must also show that the animal is eligible for carriage before you continue with the booking. <<FACT F074>> If either point is unclear, route the case to the senior coordinator and do not promise acceptance.

During planning, note whether the animal will remain in the cabin or travel under the care of the monitored team. Staff must keep their language calm and precise, because the owner often relies on the desk for clear guidance and steady reassurance. If a concern appears, follow the stepwise review process and pass the case through the proper channel rather than making assumptions. This protects the animal, supports the cabin team, and keeps Aurelia Skyways service consistent.

Remember to verify the file, follow the review path, and keep every route decision clear and measured.
